name: ICBC Pakistan TT to ICBC China account
source: ICBC Pakistan Schedule of Charges Jul-Dec 2026, https://v.icbc.com.cn/userfiles/resources/icbc/haiwai/karachi/download/2026/icbc_pakistan_branches_schedule_of_charges_jul_1st_2026_to_dec_31st_2026.pdf - outward TT 0.08% (min USD5/max USD40) + USD10 SWIFT; cny_to_deliver assumed paid in, caps not modelled; USD fees converted at USD/PKR 276.982736 (open.er-api.com, 2026-10-16); FX markup not published by the bank, so markup is illustrative

name: ICBC Pakistan TT to another bank
source: ICBC Pakistan Schedule of Charges Jul-Dec 2026, https://v.icbc.com.cn/userfiles/resources/icbc/haiwai/karachi/download/2026/icbc_pakistan_branches_schedule_of_charges_jul_1st_2026_to_dec_31st_2026.pdf - outward TT to other banks 0.1% (min USD5/max USD50) + USD10 SWIFT; caps not modelled; USD fees converted at USD/PKR 276.982736 (open.er-api.com, 2026-10-16); FX markup not published by the bank, so markup is illustrative

name: Bank Alfalah outward remittance
